summary: Core criterion (every nonempty dep id scope-checked as self-or-governed-descendant before existence/cycle validation) is genuinely proven by counterexample tests: mixed-order out-of-scope id in a list, a short non-id-shaped string, identical unrelated-vs-missing denial, and positive governed-descendant allow; decide_dependencies's refactor to a single list_tasks() fetch (confirmed via diff) preserves per-id authorize()/_target() outcomes unchanged. Note: test_set_dependencies_fetches_the_task_list_at_most_once asserts only an internal call count, an efficiency property outside 3.1's text -- a useful regression guard but not itself load-bearing for this verdict, which rests on the other tests.
